headline: Strategic Exchanges Intensify Along Divided Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Fisherman’s Row has become the busiest ledger in the theatre, with seven strategic-base events in two hours and 30 across the day; its five Colonial and four Warden holdings remain closely balanced. Lykos Isle has likewise added three fresh events, bringing its daily tally to 12, while the current count is four Warden bases to three Colonial. Weathered Expanse has seen four events, all in the latest two-hour window, and now records seven Warden holdings against two Colonial. Farranac Coast remains a heavily contested quarter at four Warden and seven Colonial bases, with 15 events in 24 hours and sharply accelerating casualty rates. Deadlands continues divided at four Warden to seven Colonial, though its three daily events are confined to The Salt March. Tempest Island stays active by the day’s record, with ten events and a two-to-seven split, but has gone quiet in the latest two hours. Kings Cage, Linn’s Mercy, Loch Mor, Marban Hollow, Clahstra, and Stlican Shelf report severe or accelerating casualty traffic without fresh base events, leaving their strategic ledgers unchanged in this packet.
